chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

My father performed ghusl from janabah. It was said to him, 'You have left a spot on your back that the water did not reach.' He said to him, 'It was not upon you; if only you had remained silent.' Then he wiped that spot with his hand.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: Sexual impurity requiring full ritual bath

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a small spot is missed during ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the principle of ease (yusr) in ritual purity, where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) demonstrates that a missed spot does not invalidate ghusl but rather requires only a simple wipe, avoiding unnecessary hardship. This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between the obligation of washing the entire body and the perfection of ensuring no dry spots remain, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of not making religion difficult for followers. It underscores the scholarly view that minor omissions in ghusl are rectified by local application of water rather than repeating the entire ritual.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘My<sup>asws</sup> father (says) wash from the sexual impurity (first), and it was said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘If there remains a spot in the back which has not been hit by the water’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘That was not upon you (to point out), if only you had remained silent’. Then one can wipe that spot with the hand’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Once my father took Ghusl (bath) because of sexual relation. Someone said to him that water has not reached to a spot on his back. He said, “It was not necessary for you to inform me. (I wish) you sought to have remained quiet.” He then wiped that spot with his hand.’”
